faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Nikflix.

items.question: Is it legal to use this extension?
items.answer: We designed this extension to be as legal as possible. It only modifies content sent by Netflix in your browser, which is legal. However, we are not responsible for any consequences from its use.

items.question: Is the extension free?
items.answer: Yes! Times are tough, especially for students. Nikflix is 100% free. If you find it useful, you can support development with a donation.

items.question: Is the extension open source?
items.answer: Yes, Nikflix is open source. The full code is available on GitHub for anyone to audit and contribute to.

items.question: What should I do if I encounter a bug?
items.answer: The extension pop-up has a quick restart button that fixes most issues. If problems persist, open an issue on GitHub or contact support.

items.question: Netflix says my device is not part of the household, what should I do?
items.answer: That's exactly why Nikflix exists! Install the extension on Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Brave, and watch without restrictions.

items.question: Does the extension work on all browsers?
items.answer: Nikflix supports Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, Opera, and all Chromium-based browsers on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items.question: Can I use Netflix at a friend's house with this extension?
items.answer: Yes! Stream anywhere: at friends' houses, on vacation, or on any Wi-Fi network without household blocks.

items.question: Will my Netflix account be banned?
items.answer: Nikflix only modifies browser requests locally without altering your account credentials. Thousands of active users have used it for months safely.

items.question: Does the extension slow down Netflix performance?
items.answer: No, Nikflix is lightweight and performance-optimized. Streaming quality remains unchanged.

items.question: Is the extension safe? Does it steal my data?
items.answer: Nikflix is 100% open source. We collect ZERO personal data and respect user privacy completely.
